goal: Encode every plugin-packaging failure mode found this session into a repo-local Claude Code project skill, so future sessions working in this repo don't rediscover them one upload attempt at a time.
name_rationale: Matches the requested location (.claude/skills/) and names the action a session takes when it loads it, consistent with this repo's plain-over-flavor-text naming convention.

steps.action: Scaffold .claude/skills/create-plugin/SKILL.md with frontmatter (name, description) that triggers on scaffolding or packaging any plugin under plugins/.
Write the manifest-location/shape rule (.claude-plugin/plugin.json required, agents as literal .md paths not directories).
Write the agent-filename rule (no dot before .md; Cowork derives the name from the basename) with the exact rejection message as a worked example.
Write the zip-building rule pointing at scripts/New-PluginZip.ps1 and explaining the Compress-Archive backslash-path and PowerShell Set-Location/.NET-CWD gotchas it exists to avoid.
Write a pre-upload verification snippet (reopen the zip, list entries) and a pointer back to this repo's own trail-logging discipline for future fixes.
Confirm the skill is scoped as repo tooling (.claude/), not a colony product plugin, and doesn't duplicate content that belongs in plugins/pmcro-orchestrator or plugins/pmcro-trail themselves.

success_criteria: SKILL.md exists at .claude/skills/create-plugin/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter
All three real failure modes from this session (manifest location, zip path separators, agent filename) are documented with their actual error text
The zip-building section defers to scripts/New-PluginZip.ps1 rather than duplicating its logic inline
No drive-letter or other host-specific paths anywhere in the file
out_of_scope: Turning this into a PMCR-O product skill under plugins/ with its own command/run/reject asset triad
Automating skill invocation (e.g. a pre-commit hook) — this is a reference skill a session reads, not an enforced gate
